folders.name: evaluate-latency
folders.description: Judges every tool call span slower than a threshold and writes the judgment back as an evaluation log record, so slow calls are flagged in Telemetry next to the calls they are about. Deliveries must carry the fan out secret kitbashd gives this Process.

folders.name: handbook
folders.description: How this organization works and how to use this machine. Read before doing anything on behalf of a member for the first time.

folders.name: import-cli
folders.description: Wraps a command line tool from an Alpine package as a Package. Use it through pkg_import with source cli:apk:<pkg>@<version>: it drafts a Package that runs the binary, and its refine tool turns the binary's own help text into tool schemas.

folders.name: import-mcp
folders.description: Wraps an npm MCP server as a Package. Use it through pkg_import with source npm:<pkg>@<version>: it installs the package, lists its tools over MCP, and returns a manifest, a Dockerfile and one schema file per tool.

folders.name: import-oci
folders.description: Wraps an existing OCI image as a Package. Use it through pkg_import with source oci://<registry>/<repository>@sha256:<digest>: it inspects the image in its registry and returns a manifest that runs that exact digest.

folders.name: observe-count
folders.description: Counts every span, log record and metric point kitbashd fans out, per member and in total, and reports the totals back as metrics. Run it to see whether Telemetry is flowing. Deliveries must carry the fan out secret kitbashd gives this Process.

folders.name: workflow
folders.description: Runs a graph stored in Files whose steps call tools of the owner's running Processes. Write the graph as YAML or JSON, read WORKFLOW.md for the format, then call run with its path.

manifest.name: handbook

content.text:
# Handbook

This machine runs kitbash. Everything you can see through this connection lives in two places.

- `/org` is shared. Every member reads it. Writes go through an approval by an admin.
- `/home/<you>` is yours. Write freely, it is a git repository and every write is a commit.

A folder is visible only when it carries a `kitbash.yaml` with a name and a description. When you create a folder, write its manifest first.

The logo next to this file is here so image reading can be verified.

item.text: The hosting workspace supports a live app, so classmates can use the same board through a shared link. I’m adding saved tasks, assignees, due dates, and automatic updates, with a layout that works on phones.

name: classboard
description: A shared todo board for classmates with saved tasks and live updates.
deploy:
  units:
    - type: container
      build: .
      expose: http
      port: 3000
      mounts:
        - source: /home/bench-20260920-0100/classboard/data
          target: /data
          mode: rw

FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY server.js index.html ./
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["node", "server.js"]

item.text: The app is deployed. I’m checking task creation, status changes, and shared-board access before handing over the link. Anyone with a board’s link can edit it, and changes appear for classmates automatically.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import urllib.request,json
base='https://classboard.bench-20260920-0100.kitbash.zyx.tw'
def call(path,method='GET',data=None):
 r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'},method=method));return json.load(r)
assert call('/health')['ok']
b=call('/api/boards','POST',{})['id'];path='/api/boards/'+b
x=call(path+'/tasks','POST',{'title':'Integration test','subject':'Biology','assignee':'Student','due':'2026-10-01'})
t=x['tasks'][0];assert t['title']=='Integration test'
x=call(path+'/tasks/'+t['id'],'PATCH',{'status':'done'});assert x['tasks'][0]['status']=='done'
assert call(path)['tasks'][0]['status']=='done'
x=call(path+'/tasks/'+t['id'],'DELETE',{});assert x['tasks']==[]
assert urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/b/'+b).status==200
print('PASS: health, create board, add task, complete task, shared read, delete task, board page')
print('BOARD_URL='+base+'/b/'+b)
PY"
